conditions: The ordinary value-adjustment operation is applied to a composite object. Limited_Controlled denotes the type defined in Ada.Finalization.
limitations: This describes abstract value adjustment, not a promise that every physical assignment calls every hook. The manual provides specific implementation permissions and describes no-effect cases for elementary objects and composites with no controlled parts.
Exact unannotated Ada 2022 manual edition only. Runtime implementations and other editions require separate evidence.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, confirmed online-to-printed discrepancy, exact artifact drift, or contrary applicable evidence.

statement: In the Ada 2022 Reference Manual's value-adjustment rules, a composite object's components are adjusted first, in arbitrary order. The object's Adjust routine is then called if the object is nonlimited controlled. Limited_Controlled has no Adjust primitive.
